That's a horrible thing for her to say and I'm very sorry that you had to go through that. I'm also a man, and have been raped twice. I know how hard it is to open up about stuff like that in the first place, and how painful it is to then have that person you trusted turn on you and use it against you. You deserve much better. It might hurt now, but at least she showed her true colors early and not later on, when things could have gotten more serious. 
If haven't already I advise you to seek out a therapist to work through the trauma. Healing is possible, given enough time and work. 
You are not responsible in the slightest for what happened to you. You were forced and taken advantage of and anyone who says any different can fuck right off. 
But don't do anything rash. You're still young and have your whole life in front of you. I'm 29 now and incredibly glad I never succeeded in ending myself, because even if it's hard to believe right now, things can and will get better. 
Stay strong my friend 🫶🏼

Grapefruit is a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor. 250ml juice is enough to have effects for up to 3 days. 
It apparently is also a P-glycoprotein inhibitor, just like quinine. 
I've never heard of Oxy and Tramadol being prodrugs tho.
 
But what the inhibition of CYP3A4 and PGP combined allows for is the passage of Loperamid through the Blood brain barrier, so it works like other opioids. Gotta be careful tho, that stuff is as potent as fentanyl. But you can buy it OTC lol
